key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:538A
name: open_graphics_intuition_libraries
description: Opens the graphics and intuition libraries and stores both handles in global data. If the second open fails, it closes the first library before reporting the failure through the error path.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:543E
name: open_screen_and_window_setup
description: Opens a screen and then a window on it, sending each failure to the error path that shows the unable-to-open messages. It saves the screen's fields in global data and copies a five-byte block and a 250-byte block into the output buffer, advancing the stored offset by 250.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:5538
name: copy_param_block_to_handle
description: Passes a stored handle, the caller's pointer argument and a length of 32 to a library copy call. It copies a 32-byte block from the argument into the buffer behind that handle.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:5554
name: copy_fixed_block_to_handle
description: Passes the same stored handle and a fixed global 32-byte buffer to the library copy call. It copies that fixed 32-byte block into the buffer behind the handle.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:5570
name: close_window_and_screen
description: Closes the stored window handle and then the stored screen handle. Both handles come from the screen and window setup routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:558C
name: close_graphics_intuition_libraries
description: Closes the two library handles stored by the library opening routine, one after the other.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:55A8
name: write_decimal_digits
description: Writes a number as decimal characters at the buffer pointer. Zero produces a single zero digit; otherwise it recurses on the quotient and emits each remainder as an ASCII digit, returning the position after the last digit.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:55BC
name: append_decimal_to_record_buffer
description: Writes a numeric value as decimal digits at the buffer pointer kept in a record, then appends one more digit and stores the advanced pointer back in the record.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:55F6
name: build_flagged_index_tables
description: Walks 64 flag bytes in order. For each set flag it stores the index in two lookup tables and advances a running count, then calls a routine with the matching word from a pointer table that moves on every eight entries.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:569A
name: interpolate_rounded_line_point
description: Computes a point a fraction of the way from a start coordinate to an end coordinate, dividing the x and y deltas by a step and rounding to nearest with correct sign handling. It writes both results to global data.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:5726
name: scale_record_position_rounded
description: Converts a record's coordinates into a rounded screen position using the record's size field, with the same round-to-nearest division as the neighbouring routine. Both results go to global data.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:577A
name: scale_record_y_rounded
description: Computes only the vertical screen position from a record's coordinate and size, rounding to nearest, and stores it in global data.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:57A8
name: record_move_entry
description: Appends an event record to a 32-entry ring buffer and links it into the list for its kind. It stores the event type, the two square fields and flags; for type 3 with differing squares it calls two follow-up routines.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:57DE
name: append_event_from_registers
description: Stores an event for the code and square passed in registers, linking it into the list for its kind and copying two more fields from a second record. For type 3 with differing squares it runs the two follow-up routines.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:57F4
name: mark_square_and_append_event
description: When the event code is not 8, it sets a flag in a table for the square's low bits, then appends an event record to the list for its kind. For type 3 with differing squares it runs the two follow-up routines.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:5856
name: append_event_at_list_tail
description: Walks a per-kind linked list to its last entry and links a new record after it. It stores the event fields in the new record and runs the two follow-up routines for a type 3 record whose squares differ.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:5872
name: link_event_after_given_tail
description: Links a new event record after the tail entry given in a register and stores its type, square and two fields. For type 3 with differing squares it runs the two follow-up routines.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:58DC
name: trivial_forwarding_wrapper
description: Only forwards the call to another routine and returns. The body has no logic of its own beyond that single forwarding call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:58F2
name: store_event_and_return_index
description: Advances the ring index, stores the event type, source and destination squares and a marker into the new entry, then returns the index. For type 5 it updates a flag from the square table, otherwise it sets a square flag.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:596A
name: store_masked_square_value
description: Looks up the byte at the square index held in a register, keeps its low three bits, stores the result in global data and returns a stored status value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:5980
name: mark_square_flag_for_kind
description: When the event kind is not 8, it sets a flag in the flag table at the position given by the square's low three bits, minus one. It then returns a stored status value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:59B6
name: build_square_event_record
description: Builds a new event record for the square and event kind passed in, filling its fields differently for each of seven kinds from the square's piece and colour bits and from lookup tables. It then links the record through the common list routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:611A
name: append_record_to_global_list
description: Appends a record to the end of the global linked list, or makes it the head when the list is empty. It clears the record's link field and returns the head that was there before the append.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:6134
name: link_record_after_chain_tail
description: Walks forward from the given record to the last record of its chain, links the new record after it and clears the new record's link field.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:6140
name: link_pointer_chain
description: Makes the second record follow the first by storing its address in the first record's link field, then clears the second record's link field.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:6150
name: remove_record_from_global_list
description: Searches the global linked list for the given record and replaces its predecessor's link with the record's successor. It then passes the removed record to a further routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:6186
name: dispatch_event_list_records
description: Walks the global event list and passes each record to the handler for its kind, of which there are eight. When a handler reports success it clears the square's entry flag and runs follow-up routines for that record. Returns 1 when the list is empty and 0 otherwise.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:6290
name: count_record_candidates
description: Counts the candidate entries of a terminated word list chosen by the record's kind, stores the count in the record and marks the record pending. It then fills two lookup values from the record's square, calls a routine with them and clears a link field.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:62B2
name: count_record_candidates_inline
description: Counts candidates in the same way as its neighbour, walking the list through a pointer held in a local slot. It then fills two lookup values from the record's square, calls a routine and stores the next pointer back in the record.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:62E0
name: count_candidates_from_register
description: Counts the candidates of the list selected by a register value and stores the count in the record, then marks the record pending. It fills two lookup values, calls a routine, clears a link field and stores the list pointer in the record.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:6306
name: mark_record_pending_with_lookup
description: Marks the record pending with the maximum step count, fills two lookup values from the record's square, calls a routine with them, clears a link field and stores the list pointer back in the record.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:6326
name: process_single_candidate_entry
description: Takes the next entry from a candidate list, computes its table position, fills two lookup values from the record's square and calls a routine with them. It then clears a link field and stores the advanced list pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:638E
name: advance_candidate_step_counter
description: While the record's step counter is below its candidate count, it takes the next candidate, advances the counter and calls routines with lookup values for the record's squares and step number. It then sets a flag and stores the list pointer back in the record.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:63C8
name: process_candidate_step_unconditional
description: Takes the next candidate of a record, increments its step counter and calls routines with lookup values for the record's squares and step number. It then stores a flag and the list pointer back in the record.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:648E
name: finish_record_processing
description: Sets a completion flag in the record, stores the list pointer back in it and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:6712
name: check_randomized_text_prompt
description: Opens a display, picks a random position in a stored text block and reads the entry there, showing it with a line count. It builds index tables of 72 and 144 text strings, then compares the typed reply with the stored text ignoring case and counts a failure on mismatch.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:6A04
name: count_record_candidates_once
description: Counts the candidates for a record whose list pointer is still empty and stores the count and list pointer in the record. It then calls routines with lookup values for the record's square and returns zero when no candidates remain. The opening word adjustment is decoded from text bytes and does not affect the candidate count.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:6A34
name: count_and_advance_candidate
description: Counts a record's candidates when its list pointer is empty, then processes the next candidate by calling routines with lookup values. It stores the list pointer back in the record and returns whether candidates remain.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:6A68
name: step_candidate_list_with_count
description: Measures the candidate list, sets the record's count and processes one candidate with lookup values. It returns true while the step counter is short of the count and stores the list pointer only in that case.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:6A82
name: process_next_candidate_step
description: Processes one candidate of a known list for the record, calling routines with lookup values for its squares and step number. It returns true while more candidates remain, and otherwise copies the record's stored lookup values.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:6B0A
name: finish_candidate_step
description: Processes the record's next candidate, sets a completion flag and calls routines with lookup values. It returns true while candidates remain, and otherwise copies the record's stored lookup values.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:6BA6
name: store_list_pointer_return_zero
description: Stores the list pointer back into the record and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:6BB0
name: step_candidate_record_once
description: When the record's step counter is nonzero it only decrements the counter. Otherwise it processes the next candidate of the list, calls routines with lookup values, sets a completion flag and returns one once the list is exhausted.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:6BD0
name: process_candidate_and_test_end
description: Processes the next candidate of a record, calling routines with lookup values for its squares, and sets a completion flag. It stores the advanced list pointer while candidates remain and returns true once the list is exhausted.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:6C30
name: process_candidate_entry_tail
description: Processes the candidate that follows the record's stored step, calling routines with lookup values and setting a flag in the record. It returns true once the list is exhausted and stores the advanced pointer while candidates remain.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:6C90
name: store_step_pointer_return_zero
description: Stores the step pointer back into the record and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:71CC
name: advance_packed_text_stream
description: Advances a packed text stream: each byte at or above 128 is sent to a routine together with a table entry chosen by its low four bits and the following byte minus 64, until a terminator. It then loads the next state byte, or clears the state at the end, and returns one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:71E8
name: advance_text_stream_state
description: Advances a packed text stream without the state check of its neighbour, sending each control pair to a routine through the same table lookup until a terminator. It then loads the next state byte and returns one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:7246
name: read_next_stream_byte
description: Reads the next byte of a packed text stream into the state field, or clears the state at the terminator, and returns one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:725A
name: read_stream_byte_unchecked
description: Reads the next byte of the packed stream into the state field and advances the stream pointer, returning one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:7268
name: clear_stream_state
description: Clears the state field of a packed stream and returns one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:7272
name: redraw_move_squares_for_record
description: Maps a record's source and destination squares to board display positions, flipping the rank index, and calls routines to redraw each. When the record is flagged, it first redraws a temporary copy of the move with a derived destination.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:72DA
name: redraw_move_squares_and_clear
description: Maps a move's source and destination squares to display positions and redraws both, then redraws the square table entry and clears the occupancy flags on both squares. When the record's kind is six it also redraws and clears a third square.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:7604
name: redraw_board_square
description: Converts a square into its display index by flipping the rank, then calls a routine with the square's table entry masked to its occupied bit and the index.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:7660
name: store_square_piece_entry
description: Chooses a code from the piece kind and the square's rank half, combines it with the piece bits and writes the result into the board table. It also stores the piece byte and the square index in their own tables.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:774E
name: clear_workspace_and_seed
description: Zeroes 512 longwords of work memory and reads a system value into global data. It derives a pair of values from a global flag and adds the difference of two readings to a global counter.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:77D2
name: check_flag_and_store
description: When the condition flag is clear, it stores a computed word and an extra register value into a global table indexed by a register. When the flag is set, it runs three routines and returns the computed value halved.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:77FC
name: add_difference_when_equal
description: If the flag bit in a register is clear it returns the values unchanged. Otherwise, when the two values are equal, it adds their difference to a global counter and calls a routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:783E
name: shift_bits_with_callback
description: Builds an eight-bit value one bit at a time, shifting an accumulator left on each pass and setting its lowest bit when the shifted value is nonzero. It calls a routine on every pass.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:7852
name: build_huffman_table
description: Reads 256 code-length and value pairs and fills a decoding table in a local buffer. Codes of up to eight bits are replicated across every slot they cover, and longer codes are stored by their prefix.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:7922
name: read_bits_from_buffer
description: Reads a variable-length bit field from the input bit buffer, locating the lowest set bit to find the current position and refilling from the source when the buffer runs out. It adds the bytes consumed to a global counter.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:7A3A
name: stub_empty_routine
description: The routine only returns and performs no operations.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:7A4C
name: refill_bit_buffer_word
description: Loads the next 16-bit word of the input into the bit buffer. When the input block is exhausted it adds a 512-byte block size to the byte counter and calls a routine to fetch the next block.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:7A94
name: read_bits_with_length
description: Reads a field of the requested bit length from the input stream, refilling the bit buffer as needed and decrementing a stored count. It returns the value read.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:7BD8
name: prime_bit_buffer
description: Clears a state word, advances the input pointer and loads the first unit into the bit buffer, with a shift mask set from the bit count argument. It adds one or two to the byte counter depending on the pointer's alignment.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:7C1A
name: adjust_counter_by_block_difference
description: Computes the distance between two stored input pointers, adds the 512-byte block size, subtracts a register value and adds the result to a global counter. It then calls a routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:7C34
name: clear_region_and_reset_state
description: Clears a large fixed-size memory region, calls three routines and zeroes a state word.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:7C5A
name: select_routine_by_state_word
description: Calls a routine, then runs one of three routines chosen by a stored state word of zero, one or two. Returns the value produced by the chosen routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:7C8C
name: initialise_run_flags
description: Sets two run flags to one and calls a sequence of routines. When a mode word is zero it calls two extra routines, then calls one final routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:7CCE
name: shift_history_entries
description: Moves the table of eight-byte history entries down by one slot, dropping the oldest, then stores the current pair in the first slot and a second record. It resets the table index to minus one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:7D3C
name: pop_history_entry
description: Decrements the history index, shifts the remaining eight-byte entries up one slot and stores the current pair in the first slot.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:7D96
name: reset_turn_state
description: Zeroes several timing and move counters and sets a limit of 200 when a flag is set. It calls routines and selects a mode value from a table indexed by a stored state.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:A062
name: square_attacked_by_side
description: Tests whether any piece of the given side can reach a square. It checks the square's table entry, then walks that side's piece list testing each piece's path to the square, returning one on the first piece that can reach it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:A108
name: inspect_unresolved_routine
description: The decompiled code for this routine was unavailable, so its behaviour is not recovered. It has 36 instructions and is called by two routines, with one direct call recorded and no referenced text.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:A178
name: find_history_position_for_piece
description: Looks up the piece at a square in the piece table and, when it matches the given kind and side, walks the saved history entries from the top for a matching piece. It returns the matching history position, or one when no entry matches.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:A20E
name: check_piece_state_eligible
description: Returns true when the piece's status word is zero and its flag byte is clear, and its kind is neither zero nor six.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:A266
name: count_matching_history_entries
description: Counts history entries from the top that pass the eligibility check, stopping at the first that fails, and returns the count.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:A2A2
name: walk_line_until_occupied
description: Walks squares outward from the current index along a line, stopping at the first occupied square. It checks the occupant against the stored piece list and returns a status value that depends on whether a matching piece was found.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:A480
name: read_word_before_record
description: Returns the 16-bit word held two bytes before the current record base.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:A488
name: test_candidate_move_legal
description: Tests a candidate move from one square to another for the piece kind and side. Kind six uses a midpoint check against the position table, and other kinds compare the stored side and kind fields before returning a result flag.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:A76E
name: append_pair_to_buffer
description: Appends a pair of values to a buffer of up to eighty entries and increments the count. It does nothing once the buffer is full.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:A79C
name: generate_moves_for_kinds
description: Sets a generation flag, runs a move-generation routine for each piece kind from two to five, then clears the flag.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:A7C8
name: generate_square_moves_for_side
description: Clears the generation state, records the source square's kind and checks adjacent squares for kind-six pieces. It then generates moves for each non-empty, non-six piece in the side's list and returns the result of the last step.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:A9A2
name: generate_targets_for_kind
description: Switches on the piece kind to list destination squares from the current square. Kind one tries the eight direction offsets, and the other kinds step along lines, passing each empty destination to a routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:ABBE
name: generate_side_move_list
description: Walks the current side's piece list and generates targets for each piece. It then handles the last two entries in a separate pass, running the same generation in reverse order, with a flag set before and cleared after.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:AE1C
name: pop_pair_from_buffer
description: Returns the next pair from the buffer while entries remain, and otherwise the default pair held in global data.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:AE58
name: extract_lowest_bit
description: Returns the lowest bit of the low 16-bit half of its argument.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:AE68
name: evaluate_board_position
description: Scores the position for the side to move. It sums each side's piece values from a table, adds a bonus term for kind-six pieces, and builds per-square control scores for both sides from direction and distance tables, then clears a working area.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:BC08
name: count_flagged_bits_in_word
description: Shifts a 16-bit word right one bit at a time, calls a bit-test routine for each bit and counts how many bits the routine reports as set.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:BC36
name: compute_weighted_score
description: Reads three values and returns their negated weighted sum, using weights of eight, twenty and forty.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:BCC4
name: lookup_weighted_table_value
description: Computes a table index from three arguments, reads a 16-bit entry at that index and adds a base value from another table at the same position.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:BD0A
name: apply_bitboard_update_score
description: Applies a bit-mask update to a stored 16-bit board entry and clears the masked bits in the companion entry. It then returns the difference between two counts taken from the updated boards.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:BDE6
name: update_bitboard_pair_score
description: Moves a mask between two stored 16-bit board entries for the given indices, then returns the difference between two counts from the updated boards.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:BF2C
name: score_candidate_move
description: Scores a candidate move by piece kind. Kind one adds a constant chosen by the side the target lies on, kind six uses the distance to a stored square, and other kinds add a material difference plus a position value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:C198
name: search_best_move_root
description: Searches the candidate moves for the side to move, tracking the best score against a bound of 32767. It stops early when a search limit or a stored move is reached and records the chosen move in global data.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:C300
name: check_search_time_remaining
description: Returns zero when the search flag is clear. Otherwise it refreshes the timing and returns zero while the counter is below its limit and the side's status is one, and one in the other cases.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:C33A
name: clear_candidate_tables
description: Zeroes 24 rows of two candidate entries and clears a count. It sets two king-position markers to minus one, then records the square of each side's kind-six piece in those markers.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:C41C
name: store_root_search_result
description: Sets a search flag from the side status byte, clears a counter and runs the search step. It stores the returned value as the best value when the counter is zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:C46E
name: inspect_unresolved_routine
description: The decompiled code for this routine was unavailable, so its behaviour is not recovered. It has 122 instructions and is called by two routines, with four direct calls recorded and no referenced text.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:C604
name: search_move_node
description: Handles one node of the move search. It records the move entry on the search stack, tries it first, then works through the remaining candidate moves in order and returns early once a result is decided.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:C91A
name: expand_search_ply
description: Expands one ply of the move search. It records the current position entry, updates the ply counter and side status, and loops through the candidate moves, swapping the side to move after each one, until the search limit or a cut-off is reached.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:CC4A
name: store_search_candidate
description: Stores a candidate move in the current search slot. When the flag is set and the piece condition holds, it first moves the previous candidate down to a second slot.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:CD30
name: test_search_cutoff
description: Returns one when a stored search entry matches the current candidate or, when no cut-off is recorded, when a second stored entry matches. Returns zero when neither applies.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:CDEC
name: update_search_lower_bound
description: Returns one when the value does not exceed the first stored bound, and raises the second stored bound to the value when it is higher.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:CE26
name: evaluate_search_leaf
description: Evaluates a search node. It sets the remaining depth, handles the case where the side's special piece is missing and clears the candidate state. It returns zero when the depth limit or a score bound decides the node, and otherwise continues the search.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:D28E
name: score_ply_bonus_cutoff
description: On the first ply it adds a bonus to the node's two score totals, based on a classification of two counts. Beyond the first few plies it returns one when a count exceeds one, and zero otherwise.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:D374
name: record_node_best_move
description: Copies the current candidate pair into the node's move slot. On the first ply it also stores the bound value as the root's best score.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:D3E4
name: try_piece_targets_for_square
description: Sets a marker for the current candidate and tries each of four target codes in turn, returning one as soon as a try succeeds. It clears the marker when none succeeds.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:D45A
name: scan_piece_attack_candidates
description: Records a kind-six piece's square and kind in the current search entry, then scans the squares one step either side of it for the other side's kind-six pieces. It calls routines for each and returns one as soon as one call succeeds.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:D6D2
name: try_targets_for_piece_kind
description: Lists the target squares for the piece at this node by kind. Kind one tries the eight direction offsets and kinds two to four step along lines, passing each empty target to a routine and returning one as soon as one succeeds.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:DAF2
name: try_candidate_pairs
description: Stores each of two candidate pairs in the node and calls a routine with it. When that succeeds it calls a second routine, returning one if a pair passes both checks and zero otherwise.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:DBE6
name: try_midpoint_neighbour_targets
description: When the node's piece is kind six and its score exceeds thirty-one, it stores the midpoint between two squares as the target and tries the neighbouring squares in turn. It returns one when a pair of checks succeeds.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:DD7E
name: unwind_search_plies
description: Steps back through the search plies, swapping the two side indices and passing each stored node to a routine. It finishes with one more call when a flag is set.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:DDFE
name: advance_search_plies
description: Runs a flagged routine on the next ply's node, then steps forward through the search plies to the saved limit, passing each node to a routine and swapping the side indices after each step.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:DE7A
name: process_message_status_flag
description: Calls routines and stores a returned value as a flag. When the status is non-zero it shows a message from the referenced text if the mode word is zero, and otherwise sets a flag and clears the status.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:E084
name: process_move_event_for_display
description: Handles one move or event record: it sets a state flag, sends a display message for the side and, for kind-six entries, computes squares and calls the move routines. The routine is large, and this summary covers only its opening branches.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:F17C
name: register_two_numbered_handlers
description: Calls a setup routine twice, once with a buffer at one fixed address and index seven, and once with another buffer and index eight. It stores each returned value in global data.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:F1B4
name: run_when_flag_clear
description: Calls two routines only when a stored flag word is zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:F1D4
name: queue_channel_command
description: When a stored flag is nonzero, it writes a short command sequence into the output queue: a channel value, pointer offsets, a sample value derived from the first argument and a command code.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:F1EC
name: start_audio_channel_one
description: Writes a sample's pointer, length, period and volume into the audio channel registers selected by its flag, together with the matching interrupt and DMA control values.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:F248
name: start_audio_channel_zero
description: Writes a sample's pointer, length, period and volume for audio channel zero from a sample record, together with the matching DMA and interrupt control values.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:F2A0
name: disable_audio_channel_by_index
description: Disables DMA and interrupts for one of two audio channels chosen by its argument, then calls a routine with the value two.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:BattleChess:0:F2BC
name: stop_audio_channel_zero
description: Clears the DMA enable and interrupt bits for audio channel zero, then calls a routine with the value two.
